title: Grammarly Alternatives
intro: Grammarly is a widely used writing assistant, but it is not the only option. Depending on whether you need proofreading, rewriting or AI drafting, a different tool may fit better — or work well alongside it.
whyLookElsewhere: You mainly need paraphrasing or summarising rather than proofreading.
You want AI drafting for long-form marketing content.
Budget: you want to compare what different free plans include.
Privacy or organisational policies limit which services you can use.

picks.note: Best considered when rewording and summarising your own text is the main job.
Worth a look if you need AI-generated first drafts for marketing and SEO content rather than proofreading.

faqs.q: Is there a free alternative to Grammarly?
faqs.a: Several writing tools offer free plans, including QuillBot. Free plans have limits, so compare what each includes on the official websites.

seo.title: Grammarly Alternatives: Writing Tools to Compare
seo.description: Looking for a Grammarly alternative? Compare writing tools for paraphrasing, summarising and AI drafting, with free plan notes.
